", "categories": {"commitment": "Full-time", "department": "Security & IT", "location": "Brazil", "team": "IT", "allLocations": ["Brazil"]}, "createdAt": 1791769609963, "descriptionPlain": "", "description": "

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Consultor(a) SAP MM SR based in Brazil.

In this role, you will support and maintain SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions, ensuring operational stability and efficiency across critical business processes.
You will handle functional support requests, troubleshoot system issues, and implement improvements to meet evolving business needs.
Working in an SAP application management services (AMS) environment, you will contribute to ongoing operations, enhancements, and project delivery.
Your expertise will help maintain service quality, resolve incidents efficiently, and ensure compliance with established service-level agreements (SLAs).
You will also leverage your knowledge of SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) to support integration across related business processes.
This remote opportunity offers a dynamic consulting environment where technical expertise, problem-solving, and service excellence are essential.
If you are an experienced SAP MM professional who enjoys optimizing systems and ensuring business continuity, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful operational impact.

", "id": "83469bfe-0a0f-4a05-a006-e54314298ece", "lists": [{"text": "Accountabilities", "content": "

  • Provide functional support and ongoing maintenance for SAP Materials Management (MM), ensuring system stability and business continuity.

  • Manage and resolve support tickets, investigate incidents, and troubleshoot functional issues within SAP MM.

  • Configure and maintain SAP MM functionalities according to business requirements and operational needs.

  • Identify, implement, and monitor system improvements to optimize processes and enhance the user experience.

  • Participate in SAP MM-related projects, enhancements, and change requests, ensuring effective delivery and alignment with business objectives.

  • Support application management services (AMS) and ongoing SAP operations, prioritizing incidents and requests according to their urgency and business impact.

  • Ensure compliance with established service-level agreements (SLAs), maintaining service quality and timely resolution of requests.

  • Collaborate with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver appropriate functional solutions.

  • Apply knowledge of SAP SD to support integration and consistency between materials management and sales and distribution processes.

  • Document configurations, incidents, solutions, and system changes to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements:

    • Solid professional experience working with SAP Materials Management (MM), including functional support, configuration, and ongoing system maintenance.

    • Knowledge of SAP Sales and Distribution (SD), particularly where processes and integrations overlap with SAP MM.

    • Previous experience in application management services (AMS), SAP support, or operational maintenance environments.

    • Experience managing support tickets, troubleshooting incidents, implementing improvements, and contributing to SAP-related projects.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex functional issues and identify effective solutions.

    • Good understanding of business processes supported by SAP MM and their importance to operational continuity.

    • Ability to prioritize requests, manage competing demands, and meet service-level agreements (SLAs).

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders.

    • A proactive, organized, and service-oriented approach, with a commitment to quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

    • Nice to have: Experience supporting organizations in the energy, utilities, or infrastructure sectors.

      • Benefits:

      • Work arrangement: Remote.

      • Contract type: Independent contractor (PJ).

      • Contract duration: Three months, with the possibility of renewal.

      • Start date: As soon as the selected candidate is approved.

      • Professional experience: The opportunity to work on SAP support, system enhancements, and application management initiatives.

      • Technical exposure: Opportunities to apply SAP MM expertise and collaborate on processes involving SAP SD.

      • Project variety: Exposure to operational support, incident management, continuous improvement, and SAP-related projects.

        •

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a .NET Backend Developer Specialist based in Brazil.

As a .NET Backend Developer Specialist, you will design, develop, and optimize robust backend services and APIs that power scalable digital solutions. You will contribute to architectural decisions, modernize existing systems, and implement high-quality software using modern .NET technologies. Working with microservices, cloud infrastructure, and containerized environments, you will help ensure application reliability, security, and performance. You will also drive observability initiatives, leveraging monitoring tools to identify issues and improve production systems. In a collaborative Agile environment, you will work closely with other engineers to promote technical excellence, share knowledge, and continuously improve development practices. This fully remote, full-time opportunity offers the chance to solve complex engineering challenges while building impactful, cloud-based solutions.

", "id": "6744b70c-b493-42c4-b87d-1e0c67820e5b", "lists": [{"text": "Accountabilities", "content": "
  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain backend APIs and services using C#, .NET Core, .NET 8, and newer versions of the .NET platform.
  • Contribute to software architecture decisions for new features and the continuous evolution of existing systems, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Apply software engineering best practices, including SOLID principles and Clean Architecture, to deliver clean, reliable, and maintainable code.
  • Develop and maintain automated unit and integration tests to ensure software quality, stability, and reliability throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Implement and enhance application observability through metrics, logs, and distributed traces to improve system visibility and troubleshooting.
  • Use Dynatrace to monitor application availability, health, and performance, identify production issues, and investigate performance bottlenecks.
  • Support the deployment and management of cloud-based services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
  • Work with Docker and Kubernetes to build, deploy, and manage containerized applications in distributed environments.
  • Design and optimize relational database interactions using SQL, working with technologies such as Oracle and PostgreSQL.
  • Implement and maintain microservices architectures and asynchronous communication mechanisms using messaging technologies such as Kafka or Google Cloud Pub/Sub.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to streamline deployments, improve delivery efficiency, and support reliable software releases.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies using Scrum or Kanban, conduct code reviews, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the continuous development of the engineering team.

    • Requirements

  • Proven professional experience developing backend applications using C#, .NET Core, .NET 8, or later versions of the .NET platform.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and integrating APIs, with a solid understanding of backend architecture and service communication.
  • Practical knowledge of automated testing, including unit tests and integration tests, to ensure code quality and application reliability.
  • Hands-on experience with Dynatrace for application monitoring, distributed tracing, observability, and performance analysis.
  • Practical knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud service deployment and management, preferably using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, ideally in production environments using GKE.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as Oracle and PostgreSQL, including query development and optimization.
  • Experience designing, developing, or maintaining microservices-based architectures.
  • Knowledge of asynchronous communication, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures, with experience using technologies such as Kafka or Google Cloud Pub/Sub.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated deployments, and modern software delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, design patterns, and software engineering best practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues and recommend effective solutions.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive approach to code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.

    • Benefits

  • Fully remote work arrangement, with the flexibility to work from Brazil.
  • Full-time employment opportunity.
  • Meal voucher to support daily meal expenses.
  • Food allowance to help cover grocery and food costs.
  • Home office allowance to support remote working needs.
  • Medical insurance.
  • Dental insurance.
  • Life insurance.
  • Birthday day off to celebrate your special day.
  • TotalPass / Wellhub membership options to support physical activity and well-being.
  • Access to the Boon Saúde app.
  • Discount partnerships and agreements with participating businesses and educational institutions.
  • Welcome kit to support your onboarding experience.
  • Structured onboarding to help you integrate into the team and understand internal processes.
  • Access to Verity Learning and professional development initiatives to encourage continuous learning and technical growth.
  • Verity Interval, an initiative supporting employee well-being and work-life balance.
  • A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture focused on transparency, trust, innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional development.
  • Opportunity to contribute to digital transformation, software modernization, cloud engineering, and innovative technology initiatives across multiple industries.
